recommendations.title: The `intent` field comments on `Plan` and `Step` in `plan_tool/schema.py` (step 1 "Add optional intent fields to Plan an
recommendations.body: The `intent` field comments on `Plan` and `Step` in `plan_tool/schema.py` (step 1 "Add optional intent fields to Plan and Step") say "empty, placeholder, and multi-line values all parse" but never state that nothing anywhere checks an intent's length, which the detail's `## Implementation` requires the comment to carry. The no-cap rule is the plan's standing fence against a `field_validator` creeping back in, and a reader of the model sees no record of it
recommendations.suggested_action: extend the `intent` comment on `plan_tool/schema.py:Plan` and `plan_tool/schema.py:Step` to state that no length cap exists anywhere

recommendations.body: `TestIntent::test_multi_line_intent_keeps_its_newlines` in `tests/test_parser.py` (step 1 "Add optional intent fields to Plan and Step") asserts only that a `|` literal block parses with newlines intact, leaving the acceptance criterion "an `intent: |` literal block round-trips with its newlines intact" unpinned; a future `yaml.safe_dump` scalar-style change could fold the newlines away with the suite still green
recommendations.suggested_action: add a `write_plan` → `parse_plan` cycle to `tests/test_parser.py:TestIntent::test_multi_line_intent_keeps_its_newlines` and re-assert both values
